# Daily Planner — Goals Tracker: Full Reference

> Your personal motivation and tasks assistant. Manage daily tasks, set routines, track goals, and stay focused — simply and effectively.

Daily Planner - Goals Tracker is a productivity app for iOS and Android designed to cut through the complexity of most planning tools. Built around the idea that the best productivity app is one you actually use — simple enough to open daily, powerful enough to keep you on track.

**Website:** https://pcristo.dev/dailyplanner_website/  
**App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/daily-planner-goals-tracker/id6757503582  
**Google Play:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pcdreams.dailyplanner  
**Platform:** iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android  
**Made by:** Paulo Cristo

---

## Core Philosophy

Tired of overcomplicated apps that don't really help you? Daily Planner delivers functionality and simplicity at the touch of a finger. Keep track of your tasks and schedule, plan and visualize progress, and manage your daily goals in a simple and effective way.

---

## Features

### Interactive UI Widgets
- Interactive timeline view showing your day at a glance
- Calendar integration for month and week views
- Simple, intuitive UI designed to keep your focus on what matters — not the app itself

### Daily Task & Goal Planning
- Create and track daily goals with completion status
- Visual progress indicators to stay motivated
- Clear overview of what's done vs. what's pending

### Custom Routine Scheduling
- Schedule your personal routine with recurring events
- Update and delete tasks easily
- Recurrent plans (Pro) save setup time for repeated activities

### Unlimited Tasks & Reminders
- Plan days, weeks, or months ahead
- Set reminders for important tasks
- Unlimited tasks and future planning (Pro)

---

## Pricing

| Tier | Features |
|------|---------|
| **Free** | Core task planning, basic timeline, calendar view |
| **Pro** | Recurring plans, unlimited tasks & reminders, extended scheduling |

Pro features available as in-app purchase.
